title: 第13章 陨落的天才
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
思索之后，林锋还是放弃了回头找人麻烦的打算，红袍青年是否独自行动，附近有没有他的同伴，这些林锋一无所知，终于还是不打算冒险。
林锋敲了敲小不点的脑袋：“臭小子，以后还敢乱跑不？”小不点不好意思的挠挠头，嘿嘿直乐。
出了大山就是一马平川，林锋师徒二人很快赶到了乌州城。
走在乌州城的大街上，看着川流不息的人群，林锋脸上露出笑容，来到这个世界快三个月了，一直都在大山里，许久没见过这么热闹的景象了。
三个月……林锋微微一叹，任务时间已经过去四分之一了，任务也只完成了四分之一而已，还有很长的路要走啊。
林锋打点起精神，便跟人打听萧家的所在。
乌州城虽然位于大秦王朝东南边陲，但却是大秦东南贸易重镇，这里紧挨着苍莽大山，大山中出产的珍惜药材和兽皮兽骨等货物都在乌州城集散，之后销往大秦全国各地。
萧焱出身的萧家在乌州城也算一方大势力，掌控了乌州三分之一以上的药材贸易。
当然了，萧家这样的地方势力跟流光剑宗这样的庞然大物，没有丝毫可比性，在萧焱天才变废柴之后，也难怪慕容嫣然会在宗门支持下上门退婚。
林锋跟人打听的重点就是最近萧家有没有什么大事发生，有没有外来人找上萧家。
当听说慕容嫣然一行人还没上门后，林锋放下了心，知道自己没来晚。
叶葛和老桃树大战一场，被老桃树打伤，看来伤的真不轻，要很长时间才能养好，慕容嫣然多半要等叶葛伤势好的差不多了，才会来乌州退婚。
林锋此时又有些患得患失起来，万一叶葛这伤一养就是半年一年，难不成自己要一直在乌州城傻等他？
“先找机会见到萧焱本人，拿天赋探测器试验一下他。”
在这乌州城里，萧焱也算是个名人了。
八岁才开始修练，一年之后达到练气五重，十二岁时练气大圆满，这样的修练速度，不要说在萧家，在乌州城冠绝古今，就算在整个大秦王朝也是闻名遐迩。
萧家虽然也是修真者家族，但不过是乌州城的地方势力，所修习道法只是三流水平，萧焱就能有如此惊人成就，若是修习上乘道法，那成就将更不可限量。
传闻当时的萧焱，名声甚至惊动了三大圣地之一的太虚观，准备来人考察将他收入门下。
彼时的少年，自信而且前途无量，眼看就要十三岁的年少时光，踏上无数修真者一辈子都未必能达到的筑基期，并且成为圣地传人，书写属于自己的传奇。
何等意气风发！何等神采飞扬！

但事态的发展在萧焱十二岁这一年急转直下。
已经打通十二重楼，练气大圆满的萧焱，一身法力突然在一天之间化为乌有，原本被打通的穴窍也一个接一个重新封闭。
练气大圆满的境界离奇的倒退回练气一重，萧焱也从云端瞬间跌落谷底。
传言要来考察的太虚观没了动静，身边的赞叹声变成叹息，甚至是恶意的嘲讽。
整个乌州城的人都在用怜悯的目光注视那个曾经的天才跌落神坛。
林锋身旁的小不点，在听过萧焱的遭遇后，也一脸黯然：“他也很不容易呢。”
“是啊，是啊。”林锋不在意的随声附和，心中却热血沸腾。
尼玛，这完全就是真命天子，主角模板啊！
用膝盖想都能想到，这萧焱突然从天才变废柴，必然是有隐情的。
正所谓先抑后扬，没有现在压抑到极致，又怎么可能有爆发呢？
而那慕容嫣然上门打脸退婚，就是爆发的临界点，等到把婚一退，这萧焱就该否极泰来，从此踏上一条大杀四方，全处全收的金光大道了。
林锋心中盘算：“萧焱从天才便废柴，必然是有某种原因的，这东西也往往是萧焱日后崛起的金手指，换言之……就是我的竞争对手了。”
慕容嫣然等人还没有到，林锋还有时间从容安排，先在城里找地方住下，安置好小不点后，林锋便径自来到萧家大宅附近。
转悠了几天，既没见到萧焱，也没等到慕容嫣然上门，林锋不由得心焦起来。
林锋考虑过直接上门装高人，不等慕容嫣然退婚，就先把萧焱收了。

content_en:
After thinking about it, Lin Feng gave up the plan of looking back to find trouble. Lin Feng knew nothing about whether the young man in red robe was acting alone and whether there were any companions nearby, so he finally decided not to take the risk.
Lin Feng knocked on the little boy's head: "You brat, do you still dare to run around in the future?" The little boy scratched his head in embarrassment, hehehe.
After leaving the mountains, there was a vast plain. Lin Feng and his apprentice quickly arrived at Wuzhou City.
Walking on the streets of Wuzhou City, looking at the endless flow of people, Lin Feng had a smile on his face. It has been almost three months since he came to this world. He has been in the mountains and has not seen such a lively scene for a long time.
Three months... Lin Feng sighed slightly, a quarter of the mission time has passed, and only a quarter of the mission has been completed. There is still a long way to go.
Lin Feng cheered up and asked people about the location of the Xiao family.
Although Wuzhou City is located on the southeastern border of the Qin Dynasty, it is an important trade town in the southeast of the Qin Dynasty. It is close to the vast mountains. Rare medicinal materials, animal skins and bones produced in the mountains are collected and distributed in Wuzhou City, and then sold to all parts of the Qin Dynasty.
The Xiao family, from which Xiao Yan was born, is considered a powerful force in Wuzhou City, controlling more than one-third of the medicinal materials trade in Wuzhou.
Of course, there is no comparison between a local power like the Xiao family and a behemoth like the Liuguang Sword Sect. After Xiao Yan became a genius, it was no wonder that Murong Yanran came to break off the engagement with the support of the sect.
The main point of Lin Feng's inquiries was whether anything major had happened to the Xiao family recently and whether any outsiders had come to the Xiao family.
When he heard that Murong Yanran and his party had not come to the door yet, Lin Feng felt relieved and knew that he was not late.
Ye Ge had a fight with Lao Peach Tree and was injured by Lao Peach Tree. It seemed that the injury was serious and it would take a long time to recover. Murong Yanran would probably wait until Ye Ge's injury was almost healed before coming to Wuzhou to break off the engagement.
Lin Feng was worried about gain and loss again at this time. If Ye Ge's injury lasted for half a year, would he have to wait for him in Wuzhou City?
"First find a chance to meet Xiao Yan himself and test him with the talent detector."
In Wuzhou City, Xiao Yan is considered a celebrity.
He started practicing at the age of eight, reached the fifth level of Qi training a year later, and reached the Great Perfection of Qi training at the age of twelve. This speed of training is unparalleled in Wuzhou City, not to mention the Xiao family, and is famous even in the entire Qin Dynasty.
Although the Xiao family is also a family of cultivators, it is just a local force in Wuzhou City. The Taoism they practice is only at the third-rate level. Xiao Yan can achieve such amazing achievements. If he practices superior Taoism, his achievements will be even more limitless.
It was rumored that Xiao Yan's reputation at that time even alarmed Taixu Guan, one of the three holy places, and they were planning to come to investigate and take him into their sect.
At that time, the young man was confident and had a bright future. When he was about to turn thirteen, he embarked on a foundation-building period that countless cultivators may not reach in their lifetime, and became a successor to the Holy Land, writing his own legend.
How high-spirited! What a high-spirited spirit!
But the situation took a turn for the worse when Xiao Yan was twelve years old.
Xiao Yan, who had already opened up the twelfth level of the building and had perfected his qi training, suddenly lost all his magic power in one day, and the acupuncture points that had been opened were re-sealed one by one.
The state of Qi Lian Dzogchen was bizarrely regressed to the first level of Qi Lian, and Xiao Yan also fell from the clouds to the bottom in an instant.
There was no movement from Taixu Temple, which was rumored to be coming for inspection, and the admirations around him turned into sighs and even malicious ridicules.
The entire Wuzhou City was watching with pity as the former genius fell from the altar.
The little one next to Lin Feng also had a sad look on his face after hearing what happened to Xiao Yan: "It's not easy for him either."
"Yes, yes." Lin Feng echoed indifferently, but his blood boiled in his heart.
Damn, this is totally the template for Mr. Right and the protagonist!
You can think of it with your knees,Xiao Yan suddenly turned from a genius to a loser, so there must be something hidden.
As the saying goes, suppress first and then rise. If it were not suppressed to the extreme now, how could it possibly explode?
And when Murong Yanran came to slap her in the face and break off the engagement, it was the critical point of the explosion. Once the marriage was called off, Xiao Yan would be able to find peace and embark on a golden road to kill everyone and take everything.
Lin Feng thought in his mind: "There must be some reason why Xiao Yan turned from a genius to a loser. This thing is often the golden finger of Xiao Yan's future rise. In other words... it is my competitor."
Murong Yanran and others had not arrived yet, so Lin Feng still had time to make arrangements calmly. He first found a place to stay in the city. After settling the little one, Lin Feng went directly to the Xiao family mansion.
After wandering around for a few days, Lin Feng couldn't help but feel anxious when he neither saw Xiao Yan nor Murong Yanran came to his door.
Lin Feng considered coming directly to pretend to be a master and take Xiao Yan away before Murong Yanran could break off the engagement.
